contract: Scope-refusal controls compare the actual constructor or compact-selection refusal with the scope established independently from the reference catalogue after draining. The remaining cases use the mpegts-pes packet projection.

The unregistered observer uses the AVC constructor and literal payload output. The input-bound and compact observers select the carriage from the accepted PMT and use the actual cursor. Compact output is consumed through its span cursor.

The candidate folds the observer packet fields and the demux clock projection of its applicable header. Check each owned or borrowed span against its offered carrier, input bytes and source context, including the physical bounds of M2TS prefixes. Require the compact span iterator and consuming cursor to produce the same sequence of spans with identical provenance.

The pinned formats worker opens the selected program with public MPEG-TS AVIO, NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, without stream discovery. It delivers ordinary entities in one AVIO source and flushes at a declared discontinuity.

The packet fold is the mpegts-pes fold: stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz ticks (INT64_MIN for absence), duration, position, flags, size, bytes and every side-data element. Input loading is outside the run. Both sides drain the last entity to logical end.
Every operation in the mpegts-pes corpus runs for each form, retaining its 272 request mappings and the hash of every ordered input.
A library refusal ends the candidate's fold with one kind 8 record; a failed check of the worker's own ends the worker with an error, which no registry entry admits.

open_refusals.reason: DemuxObserver takes no carrier with a transport error or scrambling; compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery is the opt-in that extracts such a PES
open_refusals.detail: PES carrier has a transport error or scrambling

open_refusals.reason: InputBootstrap admits a finite entity only as whole transport packets
open_refusals.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.2 fixes the 188-byte transport packet; the finite input binding requires every carrier complete
open_refusals.detail: finite PES startup needs a nonempty entity with whole transport packets

open_refusals.reason: InputBootstrap admits a finite entity only on one sync grid
open_refusals.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 places sync_byte 0x47 at every packet start; the finite input binding checks every carrier
open_refusals.detail: PES startup found missing sync bytes on the expected packet grid

open_policies.policy: A PES in a carrier whose PCR extension is out of range
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 codes program_clock_reference_extension modulo 300; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the strict source walk rejects the carrier with its payload, so none of the three observers sees the PES.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: ignores the extension and returns the 27-byte PES at PTS 90000.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pcr-extension-invalid passes)

open_policies.policy: A PES in a carrier that codes OPCR without PCR
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 allows OPCR only in a packet that carries PCR; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the strict source walk rejects the carrier with the unpaired OPCR, so no observer emits a packet.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: ignores the OPCR and returns both 27-byte PES.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts opcr-without-pcr-invalid passes)

open_policies.policy: A PES header with a zero timestamp marker bit
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 Table 2-21 requires each PTS marker_bit to be 1; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, FFmpeg-compatible view): DemuxObserver refuses the operation at the PES with Invalid (PES timestamp markers) and emits no packet; the fold ends with that refusal.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: reads the timestamp regardless and returns the 27 bytes with PTS and DTS 90000.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-timestamp-marker passes)

open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 forbids PTS_DTS_flags value 01; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, FFmpeg-compatible view): DemuxObserver refuses the operation at the PES with Invalid (forbidden PES time flags) and emits no packet; the fold ends with that refusal.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: returns the 27 bytes with neither clock.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-forbidden-time-flags passes)
